browserData.title: In-app browser
browserData.agentControlLabel: Let the agent use the in-app browser
browserData.agentControlDesc: When on, the agent can open pages, click and fill in forms in the in-app browser for you — for example to look something up or complete a flow on a website. It can only drive that one browser view: it cannot reach the Kel interface itself, and it never opens a separate Chrome window. When off, the browser still works for you; only the agent loses access.

browserData.clearDesc: Signs out of every site the browser is logged into and clears its cache. Open browser tabs take effect after a reload.
